title: isosurfaces
note: Artifact-level mind-map: every artifact placed heuristically from concept + tier + reading order. y = concept_order (timeline); x morphs from a single column (order) to concept clusters (x_spread).

concepts.key: A 3D noise field fills invisible space
concepts.truth: A 3D noise field fills invisible space with density values. Marching cubes walks the grid cube by cube — 256 possible configurations, one lookup table — and extracts geometry wherever density crosses a threshold.

Two hundred and fifty-six configurations collapse to fifteen. Every possible corner arrangement — vertex inside or outside — reduces through symmetry to a handful of cases. The lookup table is the entire algorithm.

concepts.key: Seven sculptures stand in a row. Each
concepts.truth: Seven sculptures stand in a row. Each one computed from the same algorithm, different parameters — sphere, torus, strange attractors made solid.

concepts.key: A cube has eight corners. Each corner
concepts.truth: A cube has eight corners. Each corner is inside or outside. Eight binary states: 256 configurations. For each configuration, a lookup table says where the surface cuts through.

concepts.key: Two modes of summoning form from nothi
concepts.truth: Two modes of summoning form from nothing. The fountain rises — marching cubes extract a vertical shape from a scalar field, geometry crystallizing where density crosses threshold.
Two terrains. Same algorithm, different noise. The flat landscape rolls gently — marching cubes tracing where density crosses zero, converting a scalar field into walkable ground.

concepts.key: Marching cubes at landscape scale. A t
concepts.truth: Marching cubes at landscape scale. A terrain field — noise-driven, continuous — gets sliced at a threshold. Where the function crosses zero, triangles appear. Ground forms.

concepts.key: Two views of the same algorithm. Outsi
concepts.truth: Two views of the same algorithm. Outside: terrain stretches under open sky, stone arches rise from the ground like thresholds to nowhere — portals carved by mathematics, not erosion. Inside: the cave closes around you.

Noise becomes architecture. A 3D scalar field — Perlin, simplex, whatever turbulence you choose — fills a volume with densities. Marching cubes walks through, voxel by voxel, checking each corner against a threshold.

concepts.key: Noise evolves. The isosurface chases i
concepts.truth: Noise evolves. The isosurface chases it.

concepts.key: Each metaball is a point radiating inf
concepts.truth: Each metaball is a point radiating influence. A distance field — strongest at center, fading outward. One sphere alone is trivial. But place two near each other and their fields sum.

concepts.key: A sphere is where distance from center
concepts.truth: A sphere is where distance from center equals radius. Not a mesh. Not vertices. A condition. Implicit surfaces define shape as equation — every point in space returns a signed distance. Negative means inside.
